name: Seasoning Demo — Target / Mosaic Step-Down
note_description: A worst-of autocall on Target and Mosaic, issued 15 January 2025 for three years, quarterly. Six observations have already been fixed. The worst-of has traded below the initial level throughout: it never reached an autocall rung, so the note is still alive, and the memory feature has caught up the two coupons that were missed below the 70% barrier. Because it is mid-life, the note is priced with SEASONING ON — the simulation runs from today to the original January 2028 maturity, opens at the worst-of's current level rather than at 100%, and prices only the six observations still to come. Turn seasoning off in the Position card to see the same term sheet valued as a hypothetical note issued today; the difference between the two is the point of the feature.
